extDescription.message: Convert tabs into a list, restore them later, and sync the list across devices.

cmdExecuteAction.message: Same as clicking the savetab toolbar icon

cmdSendCurrent.message: Send the current tab to savetab

cmdSendWindow.message: Send all tabs in this window to savetab

cmdSendTabGroup.message: Send all tabs in this tab group to savetab

cmdSendExcept.message: Send all tabs except this tab to savetab

cmdSendLeft.message: Send tabs on the left to savetab

cmdSendRight.message: Send tabs on the right to savetab

cmdSendAllWindows.message: Send all tabs from all windows to savetab
